title: Austin: City Growth, Lake & Dog Rules
summary:
*   **Model Cities Program:** Reviewing guidelines for a federal urban renewal initiative aimed at improving city neighborhoods.
*   **Lake Austin Infrastructure:** Discussion on new sewer and water lines planned to cross Lake Austin.
*   **Lake Austin Lowering:** Considering an extended timeline and deeper depth for the lake's temporary lowering, likely for maintenance or construction.
*   **Dog Ordinance Update:** Receiving a draft of proposed amendments to city regulations concerning dogs.
transcript:
=CITY OF AUSTIN, TEXAS
NOTICE OF SPECIAL MEETING
TO THE MEMBERS OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF AUSTIN: Notice is hereby given that a
Special Meeting of the City Council of the City of Austin will be held on the 22nd day of
January, 1968, at the Municipal Building, Eighth and Colorado, in Austin, Texas, at 10:00
A.M. for the purpose of reviewing guidelines and summary of Model City, receiving oral
report on Sanitary Sewer lines and water line construction across Lake Austin, and
considering request for extension of time for lake lowering, and at a deeper depth;
approving change order on contract for water and sewer mains in Buckingham Place and
receiving draft of proposed amendment to the dog ordinance. s/ Elsie Woosley
City Clerk
